item.title: HyperCard discovery: Neuromancer, Count Zero, Mona Lisa Overdrive (2022)
FFmpeg-over-IP – Connect to remote FFmpeg servers
item.description:
📝 Point your app at the client binary instead of ffmpeg. The client pretends to be ffmpeg. How It Works Your media server calls ffmpeg-over-ip-client with normal ffmpeg arguments The client connects to the server and sends the command with HMAC authentication The server launches its patched ffmpeg, which tunnels all file reads and writes back to the client stdout/stderr are forwarded in real-time; when ffmpeg exits, the client exits with the same code Multiple clients can connect to the same server simultaneously — each session gets its own ffmpeg process.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/steelbrain/ffmpeg-over-ip
